'''Kruluk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kruluk resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], where he worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in the [[Long Drink]], a local bar. Kruluk was good-natured and talkative, and he tried to keep himself from getting involved in any trouble, so he preferred not to get security officers involved in any altercations that took place in his bar.
